name: wikijs-sync
description: Download and upload Wiki.js pages as local Markdown files, SFTP-style, with an upload-on-save option.

wikijsSync.url.markdownDescription: Default Wiki.js base URL, e.g. `http://localhost:3000`. A `.wikisync.json` file can override this per folder with its own `"url"`.

wikijsSync.token.markdownDescription:
Default Wiki.js API token (Administration -> API Access). 

Token resolution order: `"token"` in a `.wikisync.json` -> the token saved by **Wiki.js Sync: Set API Token** (SecretStorage, recommended - not synced or written to disk) -> this setting. Prefer the command or a `.wikisync.json` for anything shared.

wikijsSync.contentDir.markdownDescription: **Legacy / fallback.** Folder that mirrors the whole wiki's page tree, used only when no `.wikisync.json` is found walking up from the file or folder you act on. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root. New setups should use `.wikisync.json` files instead.

wikijsSync.uploadOnSave.markdownDescription: Automatically upload a page to Wiki.js whenever you save its local Markdown file (if the file is inside a synced folder and passes its include/exclude rules).

wikijsSync.syncNonMarkdownAsAssets.markdownDescription: Default for a `.wikisync.json`'s `"assets"` field. `true`: non-`.md` files under a synced folder are uploaded as Wiki.js assets, mirroring their path. `false`: only `.md` files sync and everything else is ignored. Override per folder with `"assets"` in the `.wikisync.json`.

wikijsSync.exclude.markdownDescription: Default ignore globs applied to every synced folder that doesn't set its own `"exclude"`. A `.wikisync.json` can replace this list (with `"exclude"`) or restrict to a whitelist (with `"include"`).

wikijsSync.autoRenameIllegalPaths.markdownDescription: A page's Wiki.js path is derived from the file's location, and Wiki.js rejects a path containing `.`, a space, `\` or `//`. When a local file's location would produce an illegal path: `prompt` asks whether to rename the file to a legal form (with a "…All" button for bulk runs); `auto` renames silently and logs it; `off` skips the file and reports it. Illegal characters become `-`; case is preserved.

enumDescriptions: A --- YAML front-matter block at the top of each .md file (the default).
A hidden sibling file (.<name>.md.wikisync.yaml), leaving the .md as pure Markdown.
wikijsSync.metadataStorage.markdownDescription:
Where the per-page sync metadata (`id`, `title`, `description`, `tags`, `updatedAt`, `syncHash`, …) is kept.

- `frontmatter` (default): a `---` YAML block at the top of every `.md`.
- `sidecar`: a hidden sibling file `.<name>.md.wikisync.yaml`, so the `.md` itself is just Markdown — useful when the same files are also published somewhere other than the wiki. Commit the sidecar files alongside the `.md` files.

Override per folder with `"metadataStorage"` in a `.wikisync.json`. Switching modes migrates each file the next time it syncs — or run **Wiki.js Sync: Normalize Metadata (Folder)** to convert a whole tree offline.

wikijsSync.autoUpdate.markdownDescription: How to handle a newer build found on an `#wikijsSync.updateFeeds#`. `auto`: download, install and offer a reload. `prompt`: ask first. `off`: only the **Wiki.js Sync: Check for Updates** command checks. Marketplace installs update themselves and ignore this.

wikijsSync.updateFeeds.markdownDescription: Locations of a `latest.json` release manifest, tried in order (first hit wins). Each entry is an `http(s)` URL or a local/synced folder path. Leave empty on a Marketplace install.

wikijsSync.updateCheckIntervalHours.markdownDescription: Minimum hours between automatic update checks. `0` checks on every activation. The **Check for Updates** command ignores this.
